chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washa', who said: I heard al-Ridha (peace be upon him) saying:
'Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) used to wear two garments in the summer, both purchased for five hundred dirhams.

key_terms.الصَّيْفِ: the summer — signifying seasonal dress appropriate to climate
key_terms.ثَوْبَيْنِ: two garments — summer clothing appropriate to the season
key_terms.خَمْسِمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ: five hundred dirhams — a substantial sum indicating quality garments

ai.seo_question: What clothing did Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn wear in the summer according to Imam al-Ridha?
ai.summary: This narration, transmitted through Imam al-Ridha (the 8th Imam), describes how Imam Zayn al-Abidin (Ali ibn al-Husayn, the 4th Imam) wore summer clothing of significant monetary value — two garments for five hundred dirhams. This hadith illustrates that wearing quality or comfortable clothing is not merely permissible but was practiced by the Imams of Ahlulbayt, offering a counterpoint to any overly ascetic interpretation of Islamic piety. The explicit mention of the price emphasizes that such expenditure was considered lawful and appropriate for a person of status.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washa who said, 
‘I heard Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> saying:
‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> was wearing two clothes in the summer both having been bought with five hundred Dirhams’.
en.sarwar: 5. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Washsha’ who has said the following: “I once heard al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying,
‘Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, would buy two dresses for summer, each valued at five hundred dirhams.’”
